summary: Parallel analysis of all Lua 5.4 modules -> translation DAG + oracle plan

first_batch.why: True leaf: zero deps, exports NO functions - only the 257-byte const luai_ctype_ table plus header macros. A byte-for-byte const [u8;257] transcription with const-fn masks. Nothing blocks it and it is a hard prerequisite of llex.

True leaf: zero deps, no functions - only luaP_opmodes[NUM_OPCODES] (83-entry lu_byte mask array). Straight static-array transcription, byte-verifiable vs compiled C; prerequisite of lvm/lcode/lundump. Keep OpCode enum ordering in lockstep (the ORDER OP invariant).
first_functions: testAMode/getarg bit macros as const fns

first_batch.why: Its five arg-only helpers are the richest immediately-oracle-able pure surface in the whole tree - no lua_State, no GC, byte-in/byte-out. This is the natural smaz-successor beachhead and unblocks number parsing everywhere.

luaS_hash is a fully self-contained (str,len,seed)->u32 hash - the ideal standalone differential oracle - and it must be bit-exact before any intern table works. luaS_eqlngstr/luaS_hashlongstr are pure reads over constructed TStrings.

A clean tier of pure numeric helpers whose lua_State arg is used ONLY for the divide-by-zero error path; on non-degenerate inputs they are output-determined by args and fuzzable standalone. Getting Lua integer/float semantics locked early de-risks the whole arithmetic surface.

utf8_decode + u_posrelat are fully arg-determined and fuzzable byte-exact over arbitrary byte buffers with no VM. Rated 'easy'; a fast confidence-building win that also feeds lobject's utf8esc validation.

The xoshiro256** PRNG core (nextrand/rotl/project/I2d/setseed) is self-contained: fixed seed -> deterministic byte-exact math.random sequence. Must pin ONE Rand64 config (native 64-bit vs struct{h,l} 32-bit-pair) to match compiled C bit-for-bit.

Tiny buffered reader; all three fns hold lua_State only to pass opaquely to a user reader callback (lua_lock is a no-op in default build). A harness over a fixed byte buffer with a mock reader verifies it standalone. Prerequisite of llex/lundump.

luaG_getfuncline (and private getbaseline) is a pure function of a Proto's lineinfo/abslineinfo arrays - fuzzable by constructing a Proto with synthetic debug info. Isolable now even though the rest of the module needs the live VM.

synthesis.oracle_strategy: Build reference Lua 5.4 once as a static archive (liblua.a, -O2, frozen config: LUA_32BITS off, LUA_FLOAT_DOUBLE, LUA_INT_LONGLONG, native Rand64, C locale) and pin those exact macros in the Rust port so float/int/hash widths match. Three oracle tiers by function purity: (1) PURE fns (lobject helpers, luaS_hash, lvm numerics, utf8_decode, PRNG core) - compile a thin C harness that extern-declares the symbol and drives it with a shared corpus of inputs, capturing return value AND all out-params byte-for-byte; the Rust port replays the identical corpus. (2) STATE-FOR-ERROR-ONLY fns (luaV_idiv/mod, luaO_rawarith) - pass a real luaL_newstate() but restrict the fuzz domain to the non-error region for equality, and separately wrap the error branch in setjmp (lua_atpanic/pcall) to assert it as a distinct 'refused' outcome. (3) CONSTRUCTED-OBJECT fns (luaG_getfuncline over a Proto, luaH_get* over a Table, luaF_getlocalname) - build the object through the real API inside a live state to guarantee correct layout, mutate its fields to the test vector, call the target, and compare the FULL mutated struct state (not just the return), because several self-modify caching hints (t->alimit, TM flag cache). For everything in the core SCC that only means something against a running interpreter, defer differential testing until the whole core is stood up, then oracle end-to-end by loading identical bytecode/source chunks and diffing observable output (dump bytes, tostring, stack contents) against reference Lua. Emit every corpus from one generator so C oracle and Rust port consume byte-identical vectors.
new_walls_vs_smaz: Tagged unions (TValue value_/tt_, Node key union, UpVal open/closed union): smaz was flat bytes; first bites at lobject/luaO_str2num which writes a discriminated TValue, then is pervasive - needs a Rust enum or repr(C) union with manual tag discipline.

setjmp/longjmp non-local error exit: no smaz analogue; first bites at lmem/luaM_toobig and ldo/luaD_throw (also luaL_error, luaX_syntaxerror never return). Must be modeled as Result/unwind, and every 'never-returns' branch re-typed as a refusal, not a value.
Computed-goto opcode dispatch (ljumptab.h): first and only bites at lvm/luaV_execute - a ~700-line jump-table interpreter loop with no safe-Rust idiom; the single extreme wall.

Raw stack-pointer arithmetic with save/restore across a REALLOCATING stack (savestack/restorestack, StkId aliasing): first bites at ldo (luaD_reallocstack/growstack) and lapi/index2value; pointers become invalid mid-call, hostile to the borrow checker - needs index-based relocation modeling.

Intrusive linked lists spliced via double-pointers (&(*p)->next, u.open.previous holding &prev->u.open.next): first bites at lfunc (UpVal list) and lgc (gray/allgc/finobj lists) - self-referential aliasing that safe Rust forbids without indices/arena.

GC tri-color write barriers and generational age bits: first bites at lgc/luaC_barrier_; every mutator (ltable set, lstring intern, lstate init) must reproduce barrier ORDER exactly, a cross-cutting invariant smaz never had.

Function pointers across the FFI boundary with identity semantics (lua_CFunction, lua_Reader, g->frealloc, lua_Hook compared by pointer in db_gethook): first bites at lzio/lmem, sharpened at ldblib - must round-trip identity, not just behavior.

va_list / C varargs formatting (luaO_pushvfstring, luaG_runerror, luaL_error): first bites at lobject - Rust has no va_list; needs a reimplemented format walker matching Lua's %-specifier subset byte-exact.

Flexible array members and combined-block memory layout (TString contents inline, LX/LG structs with LUA_EXTRASPACE prefix + fromstate() offsetof): first bites at lstring, sharpened at lstate/lua_newstate - byte-exact struct layout the port must reproduce.

Locale/libm bit-exact float formatting and hex-float parsing (%a via frexp/ldexp, lua_number2str, decimal-point handling): first bites at lobject (lua_strx2number), sharpened at lstrlib str_format/pack - must match libc output exactly.

A core that is one giant mutually-recursive SCC with NO valid topological order (lobject<->lvm<->lstate<->lgc<->ldo<->ltable<->lparser<->lcode): smaz was a single leaf; here the dependency graph has irreducible cycles, so large regions become verifiable only after the whole cluster co-exists.

Mid-instruction reentrancy / coroutine yield resumption (luaV_finishOp restarting a half-finished opcode, lua_yieldk continuations): first bites at lvm+ldo - control state must be reconstructable across a yield boundary.
synthesis.risk_summary: Three things most likely to block 100%: (1) The core is one irreducible mutually-recursive SCC (lobject<->lvm<->lstate<->lgc<->ldo<->ltable<->lparser<->lcode) with no valid topological order - unlike smaz's single leaf, a large fraction of functions cannot be verified in isolation and only become byte-exact-testable AFTER the entire core exists in Rust, so the project has a high, all-or-nothing bootstrap threshold rather than incremental green modules. (2) luaV_execute (rated extreme): computed-goto jump-table dispatch over the full opcode set + raw stack-pointer arithmetic + mid-opcode yield reentrancy (luaV_finishOp) - no safe-Rust idiom exists, and every runtime differential test flows through this single function, so it is the critical path to any end-to-end oracle. (3) The pervasive unsafe memory model that actively resists safe Rust: StkId save/restore across reallocating stacks, the UpVal open/closed pointer-aliasing union, intrusive GC lists spliced via double-pointers, and strict GC write-barrier/free-order invariants - reproducing all of these order- and byte-exact while deciding where to quarantine unsafe (vs. re-architecting to indices/arenas, which risks diverging from C's observable behavior) is the deepest and most cross-cutting threat to reaching byte-exact-or-refused across the whole library.

Every function is a thin Lua-C wrapper over the coroutine scheduler (lua_resume/lua_yield/lua_closethread/lua_newthread) and thread-status introspection, so nothing is meaningful or fuzzable without a live VM and the resume/yield machinery. lctype.c exports NO functions — its only content is one 257-byte const lookup table `luai_ctype_[UCHAR_MAX+2]` (LUAI_DDEF). All the "ctype" behavior (lislalpha/lisdigit/lisspace/lisxdigit/lisprint/ltolower/testprop) lives as macros in lctype.h and is inlined at call sites, so there is nothing here with a C function signature to differentially fuzz. Translation is trivial: reproduce the byte-for-byte const table (a Rust `const [u8; 257]`) and the bit-mask macros as const fns; the only subtlety is the +1 index offset for EOZ (-1) and the LUA_UCID/NONA compile-time variant.
